pages.name: Caro-Kann: Panov-Botvinnik, 5...e6 6.Nf3
pages.notes: Plan 1 pushed d4-d5 into Black's d5-pawn; plan 2 put ...Nd5 on Black's own pawn; plan 4 pressured an e4-pawn that isn't there. Rewrote plans 1, 2 and 4; British spelling.

pages.name: Caro-Kann: Panov-Botvinnik, 5...e6 6.Nf3 Bb4 7.cxd5 exd5
pages.notes: The overview and plans treated it as a White isolated pawn with Black blockading on d5, but after 7...exd5 both d-pawns are isolated and d5 holds Black's pawn. Rewrote overview and both plans; British spelling.
